fields.source: Origin of the observation, such as a registration form, operations plan or forecast.
fields.segment: Group to which the signal applies.
fields.signal: Measure within that segment. Distinguish registrations, required presence, forecasts and support requests.
fields.unit: Unit of the quantity, currently people or meals.
fields.observed_at: Date the source observed the signal.
fields.confidence: Source confidence label. No numerical probability is supplied.

fields.category: Budget area, unique within this register revision. Match quote categories by disclosed meaning.
fields.planned_amount_twd: Planned category allocation in integer TWD.
fields.approval_limit_twd: Category approval ceiling in integer TWD. The brief also sets an overall ceiling.
fields.committed_amount_twd: Existing commitments in integer TWD. Account for these when assessing remaining room.
fields.owner: Team responsible for reviewing this category.

fields.quote_amount_twd: Quoted package amount in integer TWD.
fields.capacity: Coverage of this service, interpreted with package and notes. Quiet-room staffing covers quiet-room demand.
fields.available_date: Event date to which the offer applies.
fields.valid_until: Quote expiry date evaluated against the exercise business clock.
fields.status: Supplier availability or hold state, subject to recorded conditions.
fields.notes: Inclusions, exclusions and prerequisites specific to the quote.

fields.constraint_id: Identity of a single calendar constraint.
fields.owner: Team or venue responsible for the record.
fields.constraint_type: Purpose of the time or interval, including deadlines and conditional holds.
fields.end_at: End instant with UTC offset. A deadline can have equal start and end.
fields.notes: Expiry, fallback limitations, prerequisites or other qualifications.
